scope: Six small actual validate_html browser cases, two paired repeats per arm, plus three full archived root prompt replays with guidance. The original six full prompt judgments are kept separately.
outcome: Match the preregistered expected decision on controlled cases, and identify missing keyboard proof in c11 in the production replay. Passing action-only traces are insufficient for keyboard-only reachability; shortcut-only and click-only tasks do not require natural Tab traversal.
limitations: Small, single-model/day exploratory evaluation. No statistical reliability guarantee. Production application accessibility is not being judged here.
ordering: Alternate arm order across cases and repeats; serial model calls.
